people.name: Aino-Kaarina Väänänen
people.role: Guest of honour, Eero's grandmother, hard of hearing

seating.notes: Aino-Kaarina sits in the front row directly next to Päivikki, with reserved and labelled seats. Remaining front-row order is not yet decided. Ask the venue about a hearing loop or receivers. At dinner, seat Aino-Kaarina away from the DJ speakers.

photographer: Not yet booked. Lumière Fotografia must NOT be booked or contacted. A shortlist of alternatives available on 12 Sept with quotes goes to the account manager before any booking.
venue_notes: DATE DISCREPANCY: the client stated Saturday 12 September 2026, but the system date is 13 October 2026. The stated date is used as given. No binding commitments or payments until the account manager confirms the date. Only availability, quotes and written confirmations are being gathered.

Budget total_eur is 0 as a placeholder because no quotes have been received yet. The cap of 42,000 EUR is hard. Collect all-in quotes covering VAT, service charges, overtime, shuttle, equipment and interpreter. Cut fireworks first. The interpreter's booking and fee are protected and never cut, so the interpreter is not in cut_order.

Menu is not yet defined. Caterer must provide written nut-free confirmation covering cake supplier, desserts, sauces, garnishes and cross-contamination, including no almonds in the cake. A nephew carries an EpiPen. Ask whether the 96 guests include the 4 children.
Get the nearest A&E and emergency access details from the venue.
Ask the caterer and venue to confirm they can serve 96 guests.
Interpreter mic: wireless lapel or headset with spare battery, tested in the chapel before 16:00. Ask whether the chapel has a PA.
Confirm the quinta's noise and curfew rules for music until about 01:00.
Shuttle: confirm the 01:30 departure, number of vehicles, runs and headcount per run. Schedule hotel-to-quinta runs arriving before 16:00. Arrange accessible transport for Aino-Kaarina.
DJ brief must state in writing that the Macarena is banned, with written acknowledgement. Request a draft playlist and do-not-play list. DJ must be ready for either cocktail location.
Menu cards: ask the printer for the print deadline and hold the order. Add Finnish only if more than 25 of Eero's family confirm. The count is not yet known.

Heat contingency: if the forecast exceeds 32C, move cocktails to the wine cellar. Ask the venue about cellar capacity for 96 standing, cooling and ventilation, caterer and bar access, and changeover time. Suggest forecast checks at 72h and 24h before. Caterer and DJ must be ready for both locations.
Late ceremony: shorten the cocktails, never the ceremony. Dinner stays at 19:30. Tell the caterer and venue so cocktail service can be compressed.

Dog Pimienta: tell the quinta. Ask whether dogs are allowed in the chapel, grove and reception, and about leash rules, water, a quiet resting place and who looks after the dog at dinner. Tell the caterer to keep the dog out of food areas.
Fireworks: confirm whether they are booked and the cancellation terms.
Open items for the account manager and client: date confirmation, Eero's family count, whether children are in the 96, whether a photographer and fireworks are booked, and the budget allocation.
